opinions.text:
The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Illinois is denied for failure to comply with paragraphs 1 and 2 of Rule 38 and paragraph 1 of Rule 12.

Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
